about_the_game:
Step into the abandoned halls of Ravenwood 46, a 2D point-and-click psychological horror adventure where every click pulls you deeper into a story of paranoia, loss, and the unknown.

You play as Maxime Dubois, an ordinary man searching for his missing friend inside a mansion that should have been left to rot decades ago. What begins as a desperate search soon becomes a descent into shifting realities, where shadows whisper, doors lead to places that didn't exist, and something inhuman stalks your every move.

Features

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Navigate hand-crafted 2D environments filled with hidden details, interactive objects, and environmental storytelling.

  • Point-and-Click Mechanics: Search rooms, collect items and uncover the mansion’s dark secrets through classic point-and-click gameplay.

  • Narrative-Driven Horror: Piece together notes, letters, and recordings left behind by others who entered Ravenwood before you. Your perception of what’s real may not always be trustworthy.

  • Psychological Tension: No jump-scare spamming. Instead, the game builds unease through sound design, shifting visuals, and choices that slowly unravel the protagonist’s sanity.

  • Immersive Soundtrack: An original score blending eerie piano, distorted ambience, and moments of silence designed to keep you on edge.

Playtime: Ravenwood 46 Demo is a short, self-contained experience lasting around 15–30 minutes, depending on your exploration and choices.
